title: Election day
goal: Talk about elections and civic life with every kind of noun clause, and follow a story of voting day.

intro.text: This lesson brings the unit together around voting day. Facts take `-DIk` (*kime oy vereceğini söylemedi*), requests `-mA` (*kimliğini göstermesini istedi*), and a clause can be the subject (*Oyların gizli olması önemli*). The reading follows a grandmother to the ballot box.

vocab.en: vote (oy vermek, oy kullanmak: to vote)
muhtar, the elected head of a neighbourhood or village
the right to vote and to stand for election

exercises.title: Seçim günü
exercises.passage:
Pazar günü yerel seçim vardı. Sabah anneannem beni aradı ve onu sandığa götürmemi rica etti. Seksen beş yaşında olmasına rağmen hiçbir seçimi kaçırmaz.

Oy verilen okulun bahçesinde komşularımızla karşılaştık. Herkes muhtar adaylarından bahsediyordu. Biri anneanneme kime oy vereceğini sordu, ama anneannem kimseye söylemedi. “Oyların gizli olması önemli,” dedi.

Sınıfa girdik. Görevli anneannemden kimliğini göstermesini istedi, sonra ona oy pusulasını ve bir zarf verdi. Anneannem perdenin arkasına geçti ve pusulaya mührü bastı. Sonra pusulayı zarfa koyup sandığa attı.

Dönerken ona ilk oyunu ne zaman kullandığını sordum. “Gençken, yirmi iki yaşındayken,” dedi. “Benim annem genç bir kızken kadınlar seçimlerde oy kullanamıyordu. Bu hakkın kolay kazanılmadığını hiç unutmadı. Bana da hiçbir seçimi kaçırmamamı söylerdi.”

Akşam sonuçlar açıklandı. Anneannemin hangi adayı seçtiğini hâlâ bilmiyorum. Ama yeni muhtarın kim olduğunu öğrenince çok mutlu olduğunu fark ettim.

glossary.en: to run into, to meet by chance

exercises.translation: There was a local election on Sunday. In the morning my grandmother called me and asked me to take her to the polling station. Although she is eighty-five, she never misses an election. In the yard of the school where the voting took place we ran into our neighbours. Everyone was talking about the candidates for muhtar. Someone asked my grandmother who she would vote for, but she didn't tell anyone. “It's important that votes are secret,” she said. We went into the classroom. The official asked my grandmother to show her ID, then gave her the ballot paper and an envelope. My grandmother went behind the curtain and stamped the ballot paper. Then she put it in the envelope and dropped it into the ballot box. On the way back I asked her when she had first voted. “When I was young, at twenty-two,” she said. “When my mother was a young girl, women couldn't vote in elections. She never forgot that this right had not been won easily. She used to tell me never to miss an election, too.” In the evening the results were announced. I still don't know which candidate my grandmother chose. But I noticed how happy she was when she found out who the new muhtar was.

questions.q: What did the grandmother ask the writer to do?
options: Take her to the polling station
Find out who the candidates were
questions.explain: *Onu sandığa götürmemi rica etti*: a request, with `-mA` and *rica etmek*.

questions.q: Why didn't the grandmother tell anyone who she would vote for?
options: She thinks votes should stay secret
questions.explain: *Oyların gizli olması önemli*: the clause *oyların gizli olması* is the subject of *önemli*.

questions.q: What did her mother use to tell her?
options: To vote for the youngest candidate
That voting was not for women
questions.explain: *Hiçbir seçimi kaçırmamamı söylerdi*: a request in the negative, *kaçır-ma-ma-m-ı*.

questions.q: What does the writer still not know?
questions.explain: *Anneannemin hangi adayı seçtiğini hâlâ bilmiyorum*: an embedded question, with the doer in the genitive.

exercises.en: She didn't tell anyone who she would vote for.

accept: vereceğini

reject.why: *Verdiğini* is **who she voted for**. For **would vote**, use `-(y)AcAk`: *vereceğini*.
Inside a sentence the question becomes a noun: *vereceğini*, with the possessive and the accusative.

exercises.explain: *Kime oy ver-eceğ-i-n-i*: the question word stays, the verb becomes a noun.

exercises.prompt: The official asked me to show my ID.
accept: Görevli benden kimliğimi göstermemi istedi.
Görevli benden kimlik kartımı göstermemi istedi.
Görevli benden [kimliğimi|kimlik kartımı] göstermemi rica etti.
Görevli [kimliğimi|kimlik kartımı] göstermemi [istedi|rica etti].

reject.why: With *istemek*, the person asked takes the ablative: *benden*.

exercises.prompt: Kadınların 1934'te seçme ve seçilme hakkı kazandığını biliyor muydun?
accept: Did you know that women won the right to vote and stand for election in 1934?
Did you know women [won|gained|got] the right to vote and (to) [stand for election|run for office|be elected] in 1934?
Did you know that women [gained|got] the right to vote and (to) [stand for election|run for office|be elected] in 1934?
Did you know that women won the right to vote and to stand for election in 1934?
Did you know that women won the right to vote and (to) [run for office|be elected] in 1934?
Did you know (that) in 1934 women [won|gained|got] the right to vote and (to) [stand for election|run for office|be elected]?

exercises.question: *Anneannem bana kime oy vereceğimi sordu.* What did she ask?
exercises.explain: *Kime* (to whom) stays; *ver-eceğ-im-i* is the verb as a noun, with **my** possessive.

exercises.tr: Seçimin ne zaman yapılacağı belli değil.
exercises.en: It isn't clear when the election will be held.

exercises.prompt: Everyone knows that the votes are secret.
accept: Herkes oyların gizli olduğunu bilir.

exercises.prompt: We asked the mayor to open a new park.
accept: Belediye başkanından yeni bir park açmasını istedik.
Belediye başkanından yeni bir park açmasını rica ettik.
Biz belediye başkanından yeni bir park açmasını [istedik|rica ettik].

reject.answer: Belediye başkanına yeni bir park açmasını istedik.
reject.why: With *istemek*, the person asked takes the ablative: *belediye başkanından*.

exercises.explain: *Belediye başkan-ı-n-dan* (the person asked) + *yeni bir park aç-ma-s-ı-n-ı istedik*.

exercises.en: It isn't clear who the new muhtar will be.

accept: olacağı

reject.why: The clause is the subject of *belli değil*, so no accusative: *olacağı*.
*Olduğu* is **who it is**; for **will be**, use `-(y)AcAk`: *olacağı*.

exercises.explain: *Yeni muhtar-ın kim ol-acağ-ı belli değil*: an embedded question as the subject.

exercises.prompt: Anneannem hangi adayı seçtiğini kimseye söylemedi.
accept: My grandmother did not tell anyone which candidate she chose.
My grandmother did not tell anyone which candidate she [picked|voted for|had chosen|had picked|had voted for].
My grandma did not tell anyone which candidate she [chose|picked|voted for|had chosen|had picked|had voted for].
My [grandmother|grandma] told no one which candidate she [chose|picked|voted for|had chosen|had voted for].

exercises.task: You missed the residents' meeting of your building. Write three or four sentences to a neighbour: one thing you heard was decided (`-DIk` or `-(y)AcAk`), what the manager asked everyone to do (`-mA`), and one thing you still don't know (an embedded question).
models: Merhaba Selin Hanım, dünkü toplantıya gelemedim. Asansörün yenileneceğini duydum. Yönetici herkesten bu ay sonuna kadar asansör için iki yüz lira ödemesini istemiş. Ama yeni asansörün ne zaman çalışacağını bilmiyorum. Siz biliyor musunuz?
Murat Bey, toplantıda bahçeye yeni ağaçlar dikileceğini öğrendim. Yönetici de herkesten cumartesi günü arabasını bahçeden çıkarmasını rica etmiş. Ağaçların saat kaçta dikileceğini biliyor musunuz?
checklist: A fact you heard with `-DIk` or `-(y)AcAk`: *yenileneceğini duydum*
A request with `-mA`, the person asked in the ablative: *herkesten … ödemesini*
Something you don't know as an embedded question, without *mI*: *ne zaman çalışacağını*

exercises.en: I asked whether she had voted.

exercises.question: Which sentence means **It's important that every citizen votes**?

why.1: The clause is the subject of *önemli*: no accusative.
why.2: The doer takes the genitive, the clause takes no case, and an event that matters takes `-mA`.

exercises.explain: *Her vatandaş-ın oy kullan-ma-s-ı önemli*: the doer in the genitive, the clause as the subject.
